name: Rivulet
author: E. T. Carter
description: A near-black pane in front of a softly blurred field of city colour; a handful of meandering water trails descend in hash-assigned columns, each crowned by a bright refractive bead that acts as a moving lens onto the smeared neon behind the glass.

params.label: Fall speed
params.effect: Scales how fast the leading beads descend the pane, from a lazy crawl to a downpour slide.

params.label: Trail width
params.effect: Width in CSS pixels of each water trail and its refractive bead, from hairline threads to fat runnels.

params.label: Wander
params.effect: Amplitude of the side-to-side sine meander; 0 gives straight falls, high values give drunken S-curves and more visible forks.
